description: This is the main entry point for a Flutter application, defining the root widget 'MyApp' which sets up routing, theming, and initial app state based on persisted login status.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that initializes the app, sets the theme, manages routing based on login state, and provides navigation to Login and Calculator screens.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The entry point of the application, which runs the root widget 'MyApp'.

methods.name: _buildLightTheme
methods.description: Constructs and returns a ThemeData object with a light Material theme, custom color schemes, and styling for UI components.
